title: PCG, BFAR deliver fuel aid to 50 Filipino fishing boats near Bajo de Masinloc
summary: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) provided fuel assistance, ice, and water to around 50 Filipino fishing boats at Bajo de Masinloc on Tuesday…

blocks.text: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) provided fuel assistance, ice, and water to around 50 Filipino fishing boats at Bajo de Masinloc on Tuesday under the Kadiwa ng Bagong Bayaning Mangingisda (KBBM) Program.
